node: Travel and housing transaction infrastructure: property-management systems, channel managers, revenue-management software, mortgage/insurance workflows, and maintenance networks
summary: Expanded one supply-chain node around scarce operational infrastructure for travel and housing transactions. The strongest fit in this pass is not consumer-facing brands, but vertical software and workflow networks that sit inside fragmented hotel, rental-property, mortgage, and home-services operations. The two-lane list uses AppFolio as a reference-quality public comp for property-management workflow software, then adds smaller or less obvious discovery candidates: Agilysys in hospitality PMS/POS/payments, Blend in mortgage and banking workflow automation, and EverCommerce in home-services field workflow and payments. Claims are intentionally Layer 1B only; no ranking, recommendation, or valuation conclusion is implied.
